summary: Myseum.AI filed a 424B5 amendment to its February 6, 2026 prospectus supplement, updating its at-the-market offering program. The amendment reflects Benchmark's assignment of sales-agent duties to StoneX Financial Inc. and confirms approximately $2,754,500 remains available under the Sales Agreement, with no shares sold since April 23, 2026. Cumulative sales total 750,000 shares for roughly $3.3 million gross. Shares trade on Nasdaq under MYSE at $1.98 as of September 18, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation; watch for ongoing dilution and volume trends.
